content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Explain the mechanism of water movement through xylem
Explain the importance of transpiration for plants

is the loss of water vapour from plant leaves, mainly through stomata. This process drives the movement of water through the plant, from roots to leaves, through the xylem. Understanding transpiration helps explain how trees can move water to heights of over 100 metres.
= loss of water vapour from leaves
Transpiration is mainly unavoidable water loss
Occurs when stomata are open for gas exchange
Plants cannot photosynthesize without some water loss
